craft_notes: Sthāyin: dawn-order (FIRST-VERSE voice: plain, liturgical, end-weighted conduct; sets house voice — owner verdict required). Sanskrit: brāhme muhūrte...śivaśeṣavṛttiḥ → L4 keeps sequence-give-rest arc. Rows: row 2 (given→remainder). Close: remainder-conduct (vṛtti as landing: the whole day IS conduct). Rejected: 'morning prayer' — killed: god's-hour kept (brāhma muhūrta precise); softening watches — kept two (number sings).

lines: God's hour: surrender to the Lord — stillness next, restraint, then twilight;
two watches given to muttering-and-worship; the rest of time, Śiva's remainder-conduct.
l4.sanskrit_cite: brāhme muhūrte bhagavatprapatti stataḥ samādhirniyamo'tha sāndhyaḥ | yāmau japārcādi tato'nyasatraṃ | śeṣastukālaḥ śivaśeṣavṛttiḥ

reads_against.argmap: How does the day begin? → The dawn sequence orders the whole day: surrender first, then stillness, restraint, twilight; two watches given to muttering-and-worship, all remaining time conducted as Śiva's remainder.
c1_essence: Dawn sequence orders the day: surrender, stillness, restraint, twilight; two watches for muttering-and-worship, the rest as Śiva's remainder.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta with bhakti (wonder held in devotion)
